summary: A U-shaped structure featuring horizontal striped walls, a complex curved red brick roof, and two distinct towers of unequal height at the ends of the U. The building is surrounded by a low, spaced-out white block perimeter.
rebuild_hints: Lay out a U-shaped footprint first.
Build the main walls with alternating horizontal bands of the yellow and white blocks, adding vertical white pillars for detail.
Construct the two towers at the open ends of the U, making the left tower significantly taller than the right.
The roof is a complex shape that follows the U-curve, built with red bricks and trimmed with grey stone bricks.
uncertainties: Exact block palette for the yellow (sandstone vs end stone) and white (quartz vs concrete) materials.
Interior structure and floor levels are not visible.
